title: OpenAI and Google are providing advanced AI models to Singapore-based subsidiaries of Alibaba, Baidu, and Tencent, exposing a gap in US AI controls (Madhumita Murgia/Financial Times)
commentary: Singapore as the regulatory arbitrage capital of AI export controls — OpenAI and Google selling to Alibaba and Baidu subsidiaries through a geographic loophole makes the entire US controls framework look like a suggestion box.
